How to choose and import a model

Tap Download on a model: the browser downloads the file. Then come back here, tap Import and pick the downloaded file. The app doesn\'t use the internet: it recognizes catalog models by the file\'s fingerprint and checks every model before using it.

A specialized model knows a single language: in that language it is often more accurate or lighter, and the app always uses it with that language. A multilingual model works for voice messages in any language: it detects the language by itself, or uses the one chosen in “Voice message language”.
Bigger models make fewer mistakes but are slower and use more memory. Start with the recommended one; if a transcription doesn\'t convince you, try a bigger model.

You need a single ggml-….bin file, the whisper.cpp format. The final code is the quantization, how much the model is compressed: q5_0 and q5_1 are light and almost as good as the original, the best fit for a phone; q8_0 is more faithful and almost twice as heavy; f16 is the original, heavy and slow. Models ending in .en understand English only.

Parakeet, GigaAM, Zipformer, Moonshine, SenseVoice and the other sherpa-onnx models are made of several files (encoder, decoder, tokens.txt): you need the complete .tar.bz2 or .zip archive. If there are two versions, choose int8: lighter, with almost the same quality.
.gguf files (text models for llama.cpp), original .safetensors and .pt weights (they must be converted first) and a single .onnx file (you need the archive with all the files).
Models treat it as Arabic: choose models for Arabic, or one specialized in Darija or in Arabic dialects if you find it.

On Hugging Face, search for “whisper ggml” together with the language, for example “whisper ggml italian”: many specialized models also have a ggml version. sherpa-onnx archives are in the project\'s releases on GitHub, under asr-models. A model that isn\'t in the catalog can still be imported: the app asks for its name, languages and type.
Models marked “Non-commercial” can\'t be used for commercial purposes: check the license on the model page.
